summary: OpenCode Console (formerly Zen) is OpenCode's pay-as-you-go AI gateway for coding agents. Its official models page lists Big Pickle, a stealth model, as free for input, output and cached reads for a limited time; during the free period collected data may be used to improve the model. Model ID big-pickle, endpoint https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1/chat/completions, selectable in OpenCode as opencode/big-pickle. The Inference API docs permit free chat calls without an Authorization header, providing an account-optional direct API route. Optional signed-in Console/TUI setup separately instructs adding billing details and credits; this is not a Console funding waiver. No inference request was tested.
claim_steps: For the documented account-optional route, POST JSON to https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1/chat/completions with model big-pickle and messages, omitting the Authorization header. No inference request was tested.

Alternatively, sign in to OpenCode Console and copy your API key. General Console setup instructs adding billing details and credits; the direct free-chat exception does not establish a Console funding waiver.
Run /connect in the OpenCode TUI, choose the OpenCode pay-as-you-go provider, and paste your API key.
During the limited-time free period, collected data may be used to improve the model. Avoid sensitive inputs and check pricing before use.

social_proof.text: Paid models require the header; free chat models can be called without it. OpenAI Chat Completions: /inference/openai/v1/chat/completions.
